profile.headline: Software Engineer at MIT Lincoln Laboratory

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development for tunable optical transceivers.  Development in C/C++ and Python, for transceivers based on Infineon (Cypress) PSoC6 (ARM M4, bare metal, and FreeRTOS), using Modus Toolbox IDE on Windows, and Atlassian tools (Bitbucket, JIRA, Git).
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · C++ · Fiber Optic Networks · Python

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Agile Product Owner, Networking Services (OVS, OVN, OCP).  Learned Rust and Go programming languages.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Linux · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Principal Engineer/Technical Manager
positions.description: Multiservice Router Project - disaggregated routing solution using Broadcom DNX-based (Qumran) whitebox switches.  Development in C and Python, Linux.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Linux · Computer Networking · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Managed a team responsible for embedded software, primarily for the Sonos Move, battery-powered smart speaker.  Development in C++, Linux.

positions.title: Principal Engineer/Senior Manager, Platform Software
positions.description:
Part of the Oracle Communications Global Business Unit, via Acme Packet acquisition in 2013.  

Managed a team responsible for the design, development and test of Acme Packet session border controller system software on both custom NPU-based hardware (EZchip, Cavium, AMCC) and DPDK/Intel Architecture platforms.

Developed control plane software in C++ and fast path software in C using Intel DPDK libraries.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · C++ · Linux · Voice over IP (VoIP) · Network Processors · VxWorks · Assembly Language · Real-Time Transport Protocol (RTP) · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP)

positions.title: Manager, System Software
positions.description: Managed a multi-site team responsible for Broadcom's 88020/88025 programmable network processor device driver and fast path software.  Supported multiple tier 1 customers implementing 802.1ad Provider Bridging and 802.1ah Provider Backbone Bridging solutions.  Driver software development  in C, fast path processing in proprietary assembly language.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Network Processors · Assembly Language · Ethernet

positions.title: Distinguished Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for Sonus GSX9000 and GSX4000 VoIP media gateway products in C. Responsible for T1/E1/T3 device driver and DSP resource management software, on pSOS and Linux based platforms.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Linux · Voice over IP (VoIP) · pSOS

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer/Manager
positions.description: Technical lead and Manager for Appian Optical Services Activation Platform SONET/SDH team.  Development on VxWorks in C.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Fiber Optic Networks · VxWorks

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Cascade was acquired by Ascend in '97, and Ascend by Lucent in '99)
Developed system software for Frame Relay, ATM, and Packet over SONET network cards. Development in C, and custom assembly language (Maker MXT 3010).
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · Fiber Optic Networks · Computer Networking · Assembly Language
